subject.declared_domain: NFRA_GLOBGRPH P2-STITCH step-2: unions the portal/pipeline subgraph (step-1 extract_portal_stitch) with the comp-aws AWS-resource layer (the nightly snapshot) and DERIVES the inter-system STITCH edges that join them, resolving portal name/path identities to AWS ARNs so both layers meet on one ARN-keyed node. Writes stitch_graph.json -- view 2's source in NFRA_C3MATERIALIZE.

methodology.how: load_aws_layer() reads the pointer snapshots/latest.txt, fetches the named tarball and json-loads member[0]. _index_aws() builds name->arn indices for LAMBDA and S3_BUCKET plus the AWS node-key set, keying each node as (arn or id). build_stitched_graph() unions three node/edge sources (AWS snapshot, extract_portal_stitch, trace_graph.build_graph) and walks the comp-trace edges emitting five inter-layer types: ROUTES_TO, WRITES, READS, DERIVES_FROM, STORED_IN. Edges dedup on (source,target,edge_type); a wildcard- and transient-exempt 0-dangling check runs; run_grain_sentinel() gates emission and main() REFUSES to write on a grain violation (rc=2).

stages_inferential: LAMBDA identity resolution (lam(), :113-129): on a name miss it retries name.replace('_','-') then 'opal-'+hyphenated to bridge code-vs-live naming drift. A normalized candidate matching a DIFFERENT real Lambda is recorded in stats['lam_matched'] and is indistinguishable from a true match. Heuristic string normalization, no model.
STORED_IN placement (:161-169): a firm-relative key does not carry its firm, so the loop emits one edge to EVERY present firm bucket -- a possibility asserted in the grammar of a fact.
stages_deterministic: the three-way node/edge union and the (source,target,edge_type) dedup (:88-105, :171-173)
the grain sentinel gate and refuse-to-emit on violation (:243-248)

coverage.universe: Every node and edge in the union of three graphs, plus the five derived inter-layer edge types. Node universe = AWS snapshot nodes (ARN-keyed) UNION portal/pipeline nodes (path/name-keyed). Edge universe = AWS edges + portal edges + derived STITCH edges, deduped on (source,target,edge_type).
coverage.denominator: The producer PRINTS its own denominators every run and carries them in meta.stitch_stats: total_nodes, total_edges, genuine_dangling, per-type routes_to / writes / reads / derives_from / stored_in, plus lam_matched and lam_unmatched. It does NOT carry the denominator that would size its own inference: stored_in is a COUNT OF EMITTED EDGES, not of keys, so the fan-out multiplies it by the number of present firm buckets and no field records that multiplier. A reader taking stored_in as 'keys placed' overcounts by up to 5x.
explicitly_out: Lambdas whose trace name resolves to no AWS name even after normalization -- carried as _unmatched_lambdas and counted in lam_unmatched, i.e. DISCLOSED rather than silently dropped

Dangling edges whose endpoint is a wildcard/pseudo-principal (_wild: non-arn ids starting with *, event-source::, external-endpoint::, service-principal::, external-principal::, wildcard:, or containing * or ::) -- exempted from the 0-dangling check by design
ECS cluster/task endpoints (_known_transient: ':ecs:' in the id) -- exempted pending a WAVE-4-inclusive nightly derive, per CTO ruling 184757Z
S3 keys NOT under platinum/|gold/|silver/|bronze/ -- they receive no STORED_IN edge at all
firm buckets absent from the snapshot -- present_firm_buckets intersects FIRM_DATA_BUCKETS with what the snapshot carries, so a missing bucket silently reduces the fan-out rather than erroring
_genuine_dangling is TRUNCATED TO 20 in the returned dict while meta.genuine_dangling carries the true count -- the sample and the count are different quantities and only the count is complete

key.identity_space: MULTI-SPACE BY CONSTRUCTION, and reconciling the spaces is this script's purpose. AWS nodes are ARN-keyed; portal/pipeline nodes are path/name-keyed ('lambda:NAME', 's3:<key>'); trace nodes carry their own ids. The join is lam() (trace lambda name -> ARN) and the STORED_IN boundary edge (firm-relative key -> bucket ARN).
key.key_expression: For an AWS-plane node: key = (node.arn if node.arn else node.id) -- _index_aws:78 'node_keys.add(arn or nid)'. For a portal/pipeline node: key = node.id verbatim, where the id grammar is 'lambda:' + function-name for Lambdas and 's3:' + s3-key for data keys. For an emitted edge: source and target are those same key strings, so an edge endpoint is resolvable only within the union key set all_keys = aws_keys | portal_keys (:106). STORED_IN targets are bucket ARNs taken from bkt_by_name; the S3_DATA_KEY side strips the 's3:' prefix for the FIRM_KEY_PREFIXES test (key = n['id'][3:] if n['id'].startswith('s3:'), :164) but the EDGE still carries the unstripped n['id'].
key.declared_mapping: Declared in the module docstring at derive_stitch.py:11-21 (the five STITCH edge types and the name->ARN intent) and implemented at :113-129 (lam) and :161-169 (STORED_IN). The docstring declares WHAT joins; it does NOT declare that the name->ARN step may match a normalized candidate, nor that STORED_IN is one-to-many.
key.evidence: _index_aws at derive_stitch.py:72-86 (node_keys.add(arn or nid); lam_by_name[n.get('name') or nid]); lam normalization :113-129; STORED_IN and the 's3:' strip :161-169. key_expression read directly off those lines, not reconstructed. Rated UNSTABLE on two grounds read at source: the same logical Lambda is addressable under at least three spellings (trace basename, hyphenated, opal-prefixed) with no canonical form recorded on the emitted edge; and an AWS node without an arn falls back to its id, so one entity can occupy two key shapes within one run.

failure_mode.returns_on_failure: MIXED. LOUD paths: load_aws_layer() has no exception handling, so a missing pointer, absent tarball or malformed member RAISES and the run dies; a grain-sentinel violation prints GRAIN_SENTINEL_FAIL and RETURNS 2 WITHOUT WRITING (:243-248); genuine dangling edges return rc=1 while still writing. SILENT path: _load_grain_baseline() at :255-260 wraps its read in a bare 'except Exception: return {}', so an unreadable, missing or malformed baseline yields {} -- and the function's own docstring states that omitting the baseline degrades the sentinel to 'AC-GRAIN.1 only'. The instrument drops from two checks to one, prints its normal PASS render, and exits 0.
silent_degrade_paths: _load_grain_baseline() bare except at :259 -> {} -> grain sentinel runs AC-GRAIN.1 only -> a magnitude/count regression that AC-GRAIN.2 exists to catch passes unnoticed, rc=0, no warning line
lam() normalization matching a DIFFERENT real Lambda -> counted in lam_matched -> a wrong ARN is stitched and reads as a successful join
a firm bucket missing from the snapshot -> present_firm_buckets shrinks -> fewer STORED_IN edges, stored_in count drops, and nothing distinguishes that from there being fewer keys
failure_mode.evidence: EXERCISED, not read. Imported the module and called _load_grain_baseline() twice with arms reaching DIFFERENT truths: ARM1 with the real org/modules/graph/grain_baseline.json (present, 12,266 B) -> dict with 35 keys; ARM2 with GRAIN_BASELINE repointed to a nonexistent path -> dict with 0 keys. Discriminator: ARM2 == {} is True, i.e. byte-identical to a genuinely empty baseline; ARM1 != ARM2 confirms the arms are not degenerate. Source at :255-260; the 'omit -> AC-GRAIN.1 only' claim is the function's own docstring at :256.

verdict.why: The design is careful and unusually self-instrumented: it refuses to emit a grain-violating graph rather than warning, discloses its unmatched-Lambda set instead of dropping it, exempts wildcard and transient endpoints deliberately against a cited ruling, and carries its denominators in meta on every run. The artifact is current (02:38:14Z at carding) and the artifact-first/marker-last ordering was confirmed live. QUALIFIED rather than SOUND on three measured defects, none needing redesign: (1) the DECLARED cadence is not the operating one -- the nightly EventBridge->CodeBuild leg is ENABLED and has failed 20 of its 20 most recent fires, 2026-08-10 through 2026-08-29, zero successes, while a different unidentified path keeps the artifact fresh and thereby hides the outage; (2) the grain baseline loads through a bare except, so an unreadable baseline is byte-identical to an empty one and silently halves the sentinel while the run still exits 0 -- EXERCISED this session, both arms; (3) STORED_IN is a one-to-many fan-out emitted as a plain edge, asserting a possibility in the grammar of a fact, and its counter counts EDGES while reading as keys. QUALIFIED is a statement about load-bearing standing TODAY: the output is fresh and usable now, and the mechanism that is supposed to guarantee that has not worked in twenty days.
